package consumer

import (
	"context"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/api"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/api/input"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/serializers"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/web"
)

type bodyDTO struct { Name input.Presence[string]; Number input.Presence[*int64] }

func typedBody(ctx context.Context, request *web.Request, object serializers.Object) (bodyDTO, error) {
	name, err := serializers.StringField("name")
	if err != nil { return bodyDTO{}, err }
	number, err := serializers.IntegerField("number", serializers.WithNullable(), serializers.WithRequired(false))
	if err != nil { return bodyDTO{}, err }
	spec, err := serializers.NewSpec([]serializers.Field{name,number})
	if err != nil { return bodyDTO{}, err }
	body, err := input.New(spec, api.ParserConfig{MaxBodyBytes:1024},
		input.Field("name", input.String(), func(row *bodyDTO, value input.Presence[string]) { row.Name = value }),
		input.Field("number", input.Nullable(input.Integer()), func(row *bodyDTO, value input.Presence[*int64]) { row.Number = value }),
	)
	if err != nil { return bodyDTO{}, err }
	_, err = body.Schema(serializers.ModeFull)
	if err != nil { return bodyDTO{}, err }
	value, diagnostics, err := body.Bind(ctx, object, serializers.ModePartial)
	if err != nil || !diagnostics.Empty() { return bodyDTO{}, err }
	_, _ = value.Name.Get()
	if number, present := value.Number.Get(); present && number != nil { _ = *number }
	value, diagnostics, err = body.Parse(request, serializers.ModeFull)
	if !diagnostics.Empty() { return bodyDTO{}, nil }
	return value, err
}
